```{r}
counts <- read.table(file="/data/akhtar/group6/erikson_for_babesh/20260421_RNAseq_GSE159484/mRNAseq_GSE159484/featureCounts/counts.tsv", header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)

late_2cell_cols  <- colnames(counts)[grep("^late_2-cell", colnames(counts))]
early_8cell_cols <- colnames(counts)[grep("^early_8-cell", colnames(counts))]
morula_cols      <- colnames(counts)[grep("^morula", colnames(counts))]
blastocyst_cols  <- colnames(counts)[grep("^blastocyst", colnames(counts))]

# Disregard morula_rep1
morula_cols <- morula_cols[!grepl("morula_rep1", morula_cols)]
ordered_columns <- c(late_2cell_cols, early_8cell_cols, morula_cols, blastocyst_cols)

# Subset the matrix
filtered_counts <- counts[, ordered_columns]
```

```{r}
library(edgeR)

# 1. Load the gene lengths we just created
gene_len_tab <- read.table("/data/akhtar/group6/erikson_for_babesh/20260421_RNAseq_GSE159484/mRNAseq_GSE159484/featureCounts/gene_lengths.tsv", header = FALSE, sep = "\t", col.names = c("GeneID", "Length"))

# 2. Match lengths to your filtered_counts rows
# This ensures the order of lengths matches the order of genes in your matrix
matched_indices <- match(rownames(filtered_counts), gene_len_tab$GeneID)
gene_lengths <- gene_len_tab$Length[matched_indices]

# Handle any missing genes (if any genes in counts aren't in GTF)
gene_lengths[is.na(gene_lengths)] <- median(gene_lengths, na.rm = TRUE)

# 3. Calculate TPM
# Step A: Divide counts by length (in kilobases) -> RPK
rpk <- filtered_counts / (gene_lengths / 1000)

# Step B: Divide RPK by column sums and multiply by 1e6 -> TPM
tpm <- sweep(rpk, 2, colSums(rpk), "/") * 1e6

# 4. Calculate Shannon Entropy (in bits)
# Note: We divide TPM by 1e6 inside the function to get true probabilities (sum to 1)
shannon_entropy <- apply(tpm, 2, function(col) {
  p <- col / sum(col)
  p <- p[p > 0]
  return(-sum(p * log2(p)))
})

# 5. Format results
final_results <- data.frame(
  Sample = names(shannon_entropy),
  Entropy = as.numeric(shannon_entropy)
)

print(final_results)

```


```{r}
# Ensure TPM is a numeric matrix
tpm_mat <- as.matrix(tpm)

# Extract Stage names from columns
# This regex strips everything from "_rep" onwards
stage_vector <- gsub("_rep.*", "", colnames(tpm_mat))
unique_stages <- c("late_2-cell", "early_8-cell", "morula", "blastocyst")

# Calculate Mean TPM per stage
tpm_stage_mean <- sapply(unique_stages, function(st) {
    # Find columns belonging to this stage
    cols <- which(stage_vector == st)
    
    # If a stage has multiple columns, take the rowMeans
    # If only one column, return as is
    if(length(cols) > 1) {
        return(rowMeans(tpm_mat[, cols]))
    } else {
        return(tpm_mat[, cols])
    }
})

# Convert back to a matrix and keep Gene IDs
tpm_stage_mean <- as.matrix(tpm_stage_mean)
rownames(tpm_stage_mean) <- rownames(tpm_mat)

```

```{r}
# Shannon Entropy function
calc_entropy <- function(x) {
    p <- x / sum(x)
    p <- p[p > 0]
    if(length(p) == 0) return(0)
    return(-sum(p * log2(p)))
}

# Apply row-wise (to each gene)
gene_entropies <- apply(tpm_stage_mean, 1, calc_entropy)

# Create a master table
gene_summary <- data.frame(
    GeneID = rownames(tpm_stage_mean),
    Entropy = gene_entropies,
    tpm_stage_mean
)
```

```{r}
# Example: Genes specifically "active" in the Blastocyst stage
# (High expression in blastocyst, but low entropy across all stages)
blastocyst_active <- gene_summary[gene_summary$blastocyst > 10 & gene_summary$Entropy < 1.0, ]

# Example: Broadly active genes (High entropy, active across stages)
housekeeping_active <- gene_summary[rowMeans(tpm_stage_mean) > 10 & gene_summary$Entropy > 1.8, ]

# Save the Gene IDs to a list for your ATAC tool
write.table(blastocyst_active$GeneID, "blastocyst_specific_genes.txt", 
            row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

Morula_active <- gene_summary[gene_summary$morula > 10 & gene_summary$Entropy < 1.0, ]

write.table(Morula_active$GeneID, "morula_specific_genes.txt", 
            row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

late_2.cell_active <- gene_summary[gene_summary$late_2.cell > 10 & gene_summary$Entropy < 1.0, ]

write.table(Morula_active$GeneID, "late_2cell_specific_genes.txt", 
            row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

early_8.cell_active <- gene_summary[gene_summary$early_8.cell > 10 & gene_summary$Entropy < 1.0, ]

write.table(Morula_active$GeneID, "late_2cell_specific_genes.txt", 
            row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```

#save active genes to bed file plus coordinates for plotting
```{r}
library(edgeR)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------              
gtf_path <- "/data/repository/organisms/GRCm38_ensembl/gencode/m19/genes.gtf"
gtf <- read.table(gtf_path, sep="\t", header=FALSE, comment.char="#", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
colnames(gtf) <- c("chr", "source", "feature", "start", "end", "score", "strand", "frame", "attributes")

# Filter for 'gene' entries
genes_gtf <- gtf[gtf$feature == "gene", ]

# Extract IDs: This regex handles "gene_id ENSMUSGxxx.x;" with or without quotes
genes_gtf$ID <- gsub(".*gene_id \"?([^; \"]+)\"?.*", "\\1", genes_gtf$attributes)

# MATCH GTF TO YOUR FILTERED COUNTS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Assuming 'filtered_counts' is your matrix from previous steps
matched_idx <- match(rownames(filtered_counts), genes_gtf$ID)

# Create a coordinate data frame aligned to your counts
gene_coords <- data.frame(
    chr    = genes_gtf$chr[matched_idx],
    start  = genes_gtf$start[matched_idx],
    end    = genes_gtf$end[matched_idx],
    ID     = rownames(filtered_counts),
    score  = ".",
    strand = genes_gtf$strand[matched_idx]
)

# CALCULATE TPM NORMALIZATION
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Get lengths from the GTF (End - Start + 1)
lengths_bp <- (genes_gtf$end[matched_idx] - genes_gtf$start[matched_idx]) + 1

# Calculate RPK (Reads Per Kilobase)
rpk <- filtered_counts / (lengths_bp / 1000)

# Calculate TPM (Transcripts Per Million)
tpm <- sweep(rpk, 2, colSums(rpk), "/") * 1e6
tpm_mat <- as.matrix(tpm)

# CALCULATE STAGE MEANS AND GENE-WISE ENTROPY
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
unique_stages <- c("late_2-cell", "early_8-cell", "morula", "blastocyst")
stage_vector  <- gsub("_rep.*", "", colnames(tpm_mat))

# Average TPM per stage
tpm_stage_mean <- sapply(unique_stages, function(st) {
    cols <- which(stage_vector == st)
    if(length(cols) > 1) rowMeans(tpm_mat[, cols]) else tpm_mat[, cols]
})

# Shannon Entropy Function (Gene-wise diversity across stages)
calc_entropy <- function(x) {
    p <- x / sum(x); p <- p[p > 0]
    if(length(p) == 0) return(0)
    -sum(p * log2(p))
}
gene_entropies <- apply(tpm_stage_mean, 1, calc_entropy)

# INTEGRATE AND SAVE
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
final_table <- cbind(gene_coords, Entropy = gene_entropies, tpm_stage_mean)

# Filter out genes that weren't found in GTF (NAs)
final_table <- final_table[!is.na(final_table$chr), ]

# Save full data for R
write.table(final_table, "transcriptome_entropy_coords.tsv", sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=F)

# Save BED for ATAC-seq (Chromatin accessibility profiling)
# Columns: chr, start, end, name, score, strand
write.table(final_table[, 1:6], 
            file = "active_genes_for_atac.bed", 
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

#  SUBSET "ACTIVE" GENES (Optional but helpful)
# High expression in Blastocyst + High specificity (Low Entropy)
blasto_spec <- final_table[final_table$blastocyst > 10 & final_table$Entropy < 1.0, ]
write.table(blasto_spec[, 1:6], "/data/akhtar/group6/erikson_for_babesh/blastocyst_specific_active.bed", 
            sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=F, col.names=F)

late_2cell_active <- final_table[final_table$`late_2-cell` > 10 & final_table$Entropy < 1.0, ]
write.table(late_2cell_active[, 1:6], "/data/akhtar/group6/erikson_for_babesh/late_2cell_specific_active.bed", 
            sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=F, col.names=F)

early_8cell_active <- final_table[final_table$`early_8-cell` > 10 & final_table$Entropy < 1.0, ]
write.table(early_8cell_active[, 1:6], "/data/akhtar/group6/erikson_for_babesh/early_8cell_specific_active.bed", 
            sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=F, col.names=F)

morula_active <- final_table[final_table$morula > 10 & final_table$Entropy < 1.0, ]
write.table(morula_active[, 1:6], "/data/akhtar/group6/erikson_for_babesh/morula_specific_active.bed", 
            sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=F, col.names=F)



message("Success: BED files generated for ATAC-seq plotting.")

```
